## Modifications

The Z-Anatomy Blender file (`Startup.blend`) was converted by the Open Anatomy Atlas asset pipeline (`pipeline/`):

- geometry evaluated with all modifiers and curve bevels; subdivision surface capped at level 1, curve resolution capped at 6 and round-bevel resolution at 2
- world transforms baked per object; mirrored left/right instances baked with flipped triangle winding
- converted to metres, Y-up (+Y superior, +Z anterior, +X patient's left), feet at y = 0, z centred; true scale
- simplified with meshoptimizer (absolute error ≤ 0.05 mm, borders locked), quantized (16-bit positions) and compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression
- one material colour per structure (base colour only, no textures); one GLB file per body system
- names (English, Latin, French, Spanish, Portuguese) taken from the `Translations` table, definitions from the text datablocks (title line and trailing source URL separated; marked as not reviewed)
- left/right naming errors corrected after human review (`pipeline/config/overrides.json`):
  - `Eyelashes.l` → right (named left upstream)
  - `Eyelashes.r` → left (named right upstream)
  - `Lateral temporomandibular ligament.l` → right (named left upstream)
  - `Lateral temporomandibular ligament.r` → left (named right upstream)

## Definitions

Definitions are excerpts from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 3.0) as included in Z-Anatomy; every definition links its source page. They are shown as "not reviewed" until a human reviewer has checked them.
